      MCP Docs

      Model Context Protocol (MCP)

      Welcome to the Model Context Protocol documentation!

      MCP is a standardized protocol designed to enhance the interaction between Large Language Models (LLMs) and applications by providing structured context management.

      Quick Start

      • Quick Start - Get started with MCP in 5 minutes
      • Client - Installation and usage guides for different language clients
      • Build an MCP Client (Core) - Minimal viable implementation with official examples

      Core Concepts

      MCP’s core features and concepts include:

      • Sampling - Understanding MCP’s sampling mechanisms and strategies
      • Transport - Data transport and communication protocols
      • Tools - MCP toolset and usage guidelines
      • Architecture - System architecture and design principles
      • Prompts - Prompt engineering and best practices
      • Resources - Related resources and references

      Extensions

      • Extensions - Official MCP extensions (MCP Apps, OAuth, etc.)

      Why Choose MCP?

      • Standardization : Unified interfaces and protocols to simplify development
      • Efficiency : Optimized context management for enhanced model interactions
      • Extensibility : Flexible architecture supporting custom extensions
      • Ease of Use : Simple and intuitive APIs with low barrier to entry
